item.content:encoded:
A brand-new tale is beginning in the heart of North Carolina, and it has us heading in an exciting direction.

Introducing The Compass: your directional dial and go-to guide for everything coming to life at Asteria, the newest Storyliving by Disney community.

Designed as a campus of discovery, the Asteria community will be built around curiosity, connection, and exploration. It will be a place where neighbors can enjoy everyday moments together with an added touch of Disney magic.

Asteria is inspired by the natural beauty of North Carolina and will be shaped with the same care and creativity that guides everything Disney does.

There’s so much to discover, and we’re just getting started. Here’s the latest Asteria updates and news:

The post 2026 Holiday Merchandise Guide: Merry Must-Haves for Everyone on Your List appeared first on Disney Parks Blog.
item.content:encoded:
Ahh, the holidays. The ‘ber months are by far the best (in my personal opinion) and I can’t wait for the snow to start falling, the stockings to be hung, and the seasonal shopping to begin.

I’m sure we all feel even more jolly and nostalgic as this time of year rolls around, with beloved family traditions, sentimental decor, and collectibles scattered around the house, and of course, the mission to find the perfect presents for everyone on your list. This last one can be especially tricky, but everyone here at the Disney Parks Blog is happy to help.

Want to find a toy for the little ones in your life, home goods for the dedicated holiday host, or maybe matching pajamas for the whole family? We’ve got you covered with these and so much more! Stay tuned for updates as we share some merry new merchandise collections from Disney Store and fan-favorite brands over the next few months.

Unwrap Holiday Merchandise

item.content:encoded:
Hanukkah is the glow-up I wait for all year long. From lighting the menorah and playing dreidel to piling my plate with latkes, sufganiyot, and any other fried food I can get my hands on, each of the eight nights brings another opportunity to celebrate tradition, togetherness, and a little friendly competition. For the record, I’m firmly Team Applesauce when it comes to latkes, but I respect the sour cream crowd.

This year, you can make the Festival of Lights even brighter with new apparel, home décor, books, and collectibles inspired by Mickey Mouse & Friends, Star Wars, Super Heroes, and more. Fun, festive merch always helps me get into the Hanukkah spirit, so check out some finds that I’m especially excited to share.

The post Disney Eats: Foodie Guide to Holidays at Walt Disney World Resort 2026 appeared first on Disney Parks Blog.
item.content:encoded:
The holidays are almost upon us here at Walt Disney World Resort, and I am here with tidings of festive bites and sips! ‘Tis the season to eat, so stroll over to the Walt Disney World Resort Theme Parks and Disney Springs for treats certain to make your spirits bright.

For my park-goers, feast on new and returning bites such as the Peppermint-Chocolate Cookie Dough Brownie Ice Cream Sandwich at the all-new Santa’s Holiday Grove, and the Linzer Cookie Mousse Torte at ABC Commissary. The tasty celebrations continue at Disney Springs with treats such as the all-new Gingerbread Crème Brûlée at Amorette’s Patisserie and returning favorites like the Hot Sipping Ganache at The Ganachery.

And that’s not all coming to Walt Disney World Resort! Stay tuned for our official Foodie Guides to Disney Jollywood Nights, Mickey’s Very-Merry Christmas Party, and EPCOT International Festival of the Holidays. And keep an eye out for our First Look at Holidays at Jock Lindsey’s Hangar Bar!

Visions of holiday treats dancing in your head yet? Let’s unwrap this year’s offerings!

item.content:encoded:
There are some moments you know you’ll carry with you; this is one of them.

Last month, 50 students from the Central Florida area made their way down the purple carpet lined with community leaders and Disney VoluntEARS. You could see the excitement on their faces. It was more than a celebration. We had officially started the next chapter of the Disney Dreamers Academy!

What is Disney Dreamers Academy?
  • DDA launched in 2008 as a program dedicated to providing youth with the opportunity to learn how they can harness the power of their dreams. Since then, it has helped more than 1,800 students across the country build careers, lead communities, and mentor future Disney Dreamers.

item.content:encoded:
Creating magic means something different to every Disneyland Resort cast member.

Sometimes, it’s helping a family create the same kind of moments that you treasured while visiting the parks growing up. Other times, it’s seeing the pure awe on a guest’s face as they experience an attraction for the very first time.

For Riley and Nate, two attractions cast members with different paths to Disney, that meaning is especially personal. Together, their stories show how creating memories for others can be just as meaningful for the cast members who help bring those moments to life.

Fresh off the latest cast member-focused video from Disney, read on to meet Riley and Nate, and discover what creating magic at Disneyland Resort means to each of them.

As a fire and knife performer at Festival of the Lion King at Disney’s Animal Kingdom, Alema brings energy, skill, and cultural storytelling to […]

The post From The Pride Lands to the Big Screen: Meet the Animal Kingdom Performer Who Brings His Heritage Center Stage  appeared first on Disney Parks Blog.
item.content:encoded:
For cast member Alema Vaiaoga, performing at Disney is more than a job. It’s a family tradition, a way to honor his Samoan heritage, and an opportunity to inspire future generations. As a fire and knife performer at Festival of the Lion King at Disney’s Animal Kingdom, Alema brings energy, skill, and cultural storytelling to one of the most beloved live entertainment experiences at Walt Disney World.  

A Family Legacy

Long before Alema stepped onstage, his father helped to set the scene. In 1971, he joined the opening cast of the Spirit of Aloha show at Disney’s Polynesian Village Resort, helping establish fire knife dancing at Walt Disney World. In 1998, he brought that tradition to the opening cast of Festival of the Lion King. For Alema, he learned from his father during these years and developed the skills that would one day shape his own career.

“Growing up, fire performing was my baseball,” Alema said. “That was my extracurricular activity. I was learning fire knife dance with my dad behind the scenes.”

item.content:encoded:
As the wind blows and spooky season grows, embark on the Disney Destiny for Halloween on the High Seas sailings.

During your cruise, enjoy trick-or-treating, Mickey’s Mouse-Querade Party, and an exclusive new Halloween character only found on the Disney Destiny.

Meet Solara, the newest Enchanted Pumpkin Tree in the Disney Cruise Line fleet. She is adorned with glowing gourds and glistening dew.

The inspiration for Solara began with the theme of the ship, heroes and villains. And for Halloween, Disney Live Entertainment explored the duality of the season where guests can choose to celebrate Halloween: with fright, delight or a little of both.
